name: "Activate the Congress" Online Platform
content: Problems and Purpose “Activate the Congress” (Span. Activá el Congreso) is a digital platform created in March 2018, with the aim of facilitating direct communication between citizens and their representatives. It seeks to amplify the power of citizen demands through direct contact with senators and congressmen, through their Facebook accounts, Twitter and phone calls. The purpose is to allow them to engage in dialogue on relevant issues of the national political agenda, and to potentially influence the decisions made by citizens in the legislative sphere. Influence, Outcomes, and Effects Following the abortion debate, "Activate the Congress" seeks to get involved in other issues of national interest for which an interesting discussion can be created.
